title: Double Date
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office staff navigates various personal and social conflicts, including Michael introducing Helene to the office, a planned birthday celebration, and a confrontation involving Pam and Michael that leads to a physical altercation. The episode explores relationships, misunderstandings, and humorous interactions among the characters.
